info.title: Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) Commodity Prices Data Contract
info.description: Enforced Silver-tier conformed market prices contract for agricultural and food commodities across Sri Lankan trading hubs.
info.owner: Data Platform Architecture & Financial Analytics Team

stg_cbsl_commodity_prices.description: Standardized, deduplicated, and financial-grade commodity observations from CBSL economic centers.

commodity_sk.description: Deterministic SHA-256 surrogate primary key (hash of commodity_id, market_center, trade_date).

recorded_date.description: Official observation trading date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

commodity_code.description: CBSL standard commodity identifier slug (e.g., RICE_SAMBA, POTATO_LOCAL).

market_location.description: Wholesale market economic center (Pettah, Dambulla, Narahenpita, Kandy, Thambuththegama).

retail_price_lkr.description: Conformed retail consumer price in Sri Lankan Rupees.

wholesale_price_lkr.description: Conformed wholesale trading price in Sri Lankan Rupees.

ingested_at.description: UTC lineage ingestion timestamp marking landing into lakehouse bronze storage.

quality.name: assert_no_negative_spreads
quality.description: Retail price must strictly meet or exceed wholesale price for all market records.
quality.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_cbsl_commodity_prices WHERE retail_price_lkr < wholesale_price_lkr

quality.name: assert_price_volatility_threshold
quality.description: Day-over-day price shifts exceeding 50% must trigger anomaly blocking.

quality.name: assert_volume_drift
quality.description: Daily record volume must not drop more than 20% compared to 7-day rolling average.
